acquisition.cache_source: pre-existing official Binance public archive cache
acquisition.provenance: clone or copy cached ZIP and adjacent official .CHECKSUM bytes into the packet-owned source root; hash both local objects and verify the ZIP digest against the sidecar
acquisition.source_url_role: official origin provenance only; not evidence of an S1V HTTP request, current HTTP status, or equality with current remote bytes

archive_root_role: official origin provenance for cached paths only; not an engine network target

archive_validation.csv_encoding: UTF-8 ASCII-compatible header and finite decimal fields
archive_validation.funding_month_boundary: each funding CSV, when its custody phase permits member opening, is nonempty; first calc_time is within 1.5 * first interval * 3600000 + 1000 milliseconds after its UTC month start; last calc_time is within 1.5 * last interval * 3600000 + 1000 milliseconds before its UTC month end
archive_validation.funding_row_semantics: finite last_funding_rate; unique strictly increasing integer-millisecond calc_time; integer funding_interval_hours from 1 through 24; adjacent gap <= 1.5 * max(left interval, right interval) * 3600000 + 1000 milliseconds
archive_validation.funding_stitched_semantics: phase-scoped only: the screen validates June; after the O_EXCL development run marker, validate and stitch June through March; only after every development gate passes, one champion candidate seal is written, and the holdout_open marker is created, validate and stitch March through June; within each permitted stitch, calc_time is strictly increasing and unique and every adjacent gap is <= 1.5 * max(left interval, right interval) * 3600000 + 1000 milliseconds; no April-through-June member is opened before those gates and markers
archive_validation.phase_open_rule: the pre-development manifest hashes ZIP and sidecar bytes and verifies ZIP checksums only, without opening post-screen CSV members; the screen validates June; after O_EXCL run_consumed.v1.json creation development validates June through March; only after all development gates pass, candidate_seal.v1.json is written, and holdout_open.v1.json is created may the holdout validation open April-through-June members and use the already development-validated March boundary
archive_validation.selected_kline_coverage: each selected kind and month, when its custody phase permits member opening, must contain the exact distinct UTC-hour grid for that calendar month with no missing or extra open
archive_validation.zip: single expected regular CSV member; no nested path, duplicate member, encryption, symlink, or extra member

artifact_contract.canonical_json: All packet JSON is UTF-8, key-sorted compact JSON with one trailing LF.
directed_hash_chain: preseal.v1.json binds the complete static-file byte digests and canonical base commit

universe.v1.json binds screen_consumed.v1.json, the full sorted candidate-attempt ledger, exact June archive_member_open_count reconciliation, all successful June evidence digests, every row reason_code, and the mechanical selected-30 projection
source_manifest.v1.json binds universe.v1.json and all 1170 selected ZIP/sidecar pairs
freeze.v1.json binds static files, preseal, screen marker, universe, and source manifest
development.v1.json binds run_consumed.v1.json, freeze.v1.json, protocol.v1.json, and trial_ledger.v1.json
candidate_seal.v1.json binds development.v1.json and the single champion when and only when all development gates pass
holdout_open.v1.json binds candidate_seal.v1.json before any April-through-June member opening
holdout.v1.json binds holdout_open.v1.json and the sealed champion evaluation
result.v1.json binds the applicable terminal chain; SHA256SUMS binds every final packet file except itself
artifact_contract.self_digest_convention: No JSON artifact contains a literal self-digest. preseal.v1.json binds static file hashes; freeze.v1.json binds the directed parent-child hash chain and source freeze; final SHA256SUMS binds complete on-disk bytes.

development.member_open: after complete selected-source manifest freeze and O_EXCL run marker only

holdout.embargo: 2026-04-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-04-08T00:00:00Z; lagged state only after holdout opening and never scored
holdout.member_open: only after every development gate passes, one champion candidate seal is written, and holdout_open.v1.json is created before the first April-through-June archive member is opened

screen.purpose: universe selection and lagged signal warmup only

run_custody.marker_creation: atomic O_CREAT|O_EXCL before any post-screen ZIP member is opened

schema_probe_disclosure.holdout_custody_claim: selected source-root holdout outcome rows remain unopened unless development gates pass

screen_stage_1_inventory.local_reuse: clone or copy all six cached June ZIP/sidecar objects per candidate symbol into the packet-owned screen area
screen_stage_1_inventory.marker_creation: atomic O_CREAT|O_EXCL before the first ZIP member is opened
screen_stage_1_inventory.sidecar_validation: exactly one lowercase or uppercase hexadecimal SHA-256 token and the exact ZIP basename; ZIP digest must match
screen_stage_1_inventory.symbol_discovery: inventory cached official monthly fundingRate basenames ending USDT, then intersect with cached symbols having all three required ZIPs and adjacent official sidecars; no network listing

attempt_ledger.aggregate_reconciliation: screen_attempt_count equals len(screen_attempts); candidate_count equals count(status SUCCESS); top-level screen_archive_member_open_count equals the exact sum of every row archive_member_open_count
attempt_ledger.excluded_candidate_proof: invalid rows retain their stable first EvidenceError code in reason_code and successful rows below rank 30 remain in the ledger; no attempted candidate is omitted
attempt_ledger.order: one row per attempted stage-1 candidate, symbol ASCII ascending
attempt_ledger.reason_code_rule: reason_code is null for SUCCESS and a stable first EvidenceError code string for INVALID_EVIDENCE
attempt_ledger.success_june_evidence: exactly three kind keys fundingRate, klines_1h, and markPriceKlines_1h, each containing zip_sha256 and sidecar_sha256

screen_stage_2_open.frozen_evidence: for every successful attempt: symbol, archive_member_open_count, reason_code null, exact contract-quote-volume sum, and SHA-256 of each of the three June ZIPs and sidecars; for every invalid attempt: symbol, archive_member_open_count, and stable first-failure reason_code
screen_stage_2_open.funding_rows: nonempty and strictly within June; finite rate; integer interval from 1 through 24 hours; increasing unique millisecond calc_time; first and last rows meet their 1.5*interval+1000ms month-boundary tolerance; adjacent gap <= 1.5 * max(left interval, right interval) * 3600000 + 1000 milliseconds
screen_stage_2_open.kline_rows: exactly 720 distinct consecutive UTC hourly opens from 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z through 2025-06-30T23:00:00Z
screen_stage_2_open.metric: sum of USD-M contract-klines quote_asset_volume across all 720 rows
screen_stage_2_open.selection: from all and only SUCCESS attempt rows, rank numeric screen_quote_volume descending then symbol ASCII ascending; screen_rows is exactly the first 30 complete success rows and selected_symbols is their symbol projection

selected_source_freeze.acquisition_policy: clone or copy every selected cached ZIP and adjacent official sidecar into the packet-owned source root, hash both, verify every ZIP digest against its sidecar, then freeze the complete manifest; this pre-development step inspects ZIP and sidecar bytes only and does not open any post-screen archive member
selected_source_freeze.development_funding_validation: after O_EXCL run_consumed.v1.json creation, validate and stitch June 2025 through March 2026, with June already screen-validated; enforce all per-month endpoint and stitched-gap rules
selected_source_freeze.holdout_funding_validation: only after every development gate passes, candidate_seal.v1.json is written, and holdout_open.v1.json is created before member opening, validate and stitch March through June 2026, with March already development-validated; never open April-through-June members before those gates and markers
selected_source_freeze.manifest_source_url: official data.binance.vision origin path retained as provenance only
selected_source_freeze.official_archive_revision: the official archive may have been revised remotely; the packet-owned checksum-verified cached bytes and their frozen digests are the evaluated evidence, with no claim of current remote equality
selected_source_freeze.predevelopment_manifest_validation: hash ZIP and adjacent official .CHECKSUM sidecar bytes and verify every ZIP digest against its sidecar only; do not open post-screen CSV members
selected_source_freeze.reuse_screen_bytes: allowed only when byte and sidecar digests exactly match the frozen June screen evidence

source_authority_role: publisher origin label retained in the manifest; no S1V HTTP acquisition or current-remote-equality claim
